Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 6
Reason for Mistake: In the final decision step (Step 6), the Planner incorrectly summarized the information found on the Britannica page. While the page clearly states Eugene V. Debs was a candidate of the "Socialist Party of America" and a founder of that party, the Planner's analysis erroneously claimed the page showed an affiliation with the "Social Democratic Party of America (SDPA)." The Socialist Party of America and the Social Democratic Party of America are distinct entities; Debs was a leader of the former. This hallucination in the analysis led the Planner to output the wrong final answer ("Social Democratic Party of America" instead of "Socialist Party of America").
